appearance.browser: Four complete authored levels retain every tube termination, both primary masts and ancillary aerials, five west ledges, all eleven mapped podium parts, the curved skylight and twelve canopy footprints. Three existing256px graphs provide painted metal, concrete and wood; bronze glazing and clear ledges remain local, and roof planting retains a local green material. Skyline uses bronze fields and aggregated structural rhythm, mechanical bands and coarse masts. District aggregates windows across8-floor/five-bay groups, guards/planting and canopy borders; street uses three-floor/ten-bay glazing, true ledges and coarse open mast lattice. Closeup restores every storey and ten-bay rhythm, projecting piers, louver blades, roof machinery, lattice braces, storefronts and denser skylight/planting. Original fine facade/mast hardware remains in the master. Aggregated window colors preserve the source ratio of bronze glass to dark spandrels so distant tiers do not brighten as storeys merge.

The two highest tubes remain west/center and five ledges remain on native-X west.

Skyline aggregates facade bays, roof plant, antenna lattice and glass ledges; district aggregates eight-storey/five-bay window groups and minor guards/canopy borders; street restores three-storey/ten-bay rhythm and coarse lattice. Closeup restores every storey, ten bays, projecting piers and coarser genuine louvers. Fine mullion lips, seat slats, collars, greenery and roof-guard posts remain explicit reductions.

Existing shared painted-metal/concrete/timber graphs supply texture memory reuse; no per-model bitmap textures or embedded images. Bronze/transparent glazing are local material colors. Optical reflections, surveyed skylight curvature, exact planting and physical laptop/phone performance remain unverified.
